sources.title: DeBERTa-v3 · Model card | CodeSOTA
sources.snippet: In DeBERTa V3, we further improved the efficiency of DeBERTa using ELECTRA-Style pre-training with Gradient Disentangled Embedding Sharing. Compared to DeBERTa, our V3 version significantly improves the model performance on downstream tasks. You can find more technique details about the new model from our paper.

sources.title: Deberta V3 Large - Specs, Capabilities & Benchmarks | Inferbase
sources.snippet: Deberta V3 Large is a chat model developed by Microsoft, exceling at text generation tasks. Its notable technical trait is the use of ELECTRA-Style pre-training with Gradient Disentangled Embedding Sharing, which significantly improves model performance on downstream tasks.
